verdict: ARTIFACT. The priced-stopping advantage over the fixed deadline is carried by container-setup commands. With them removed the advantage is negative in both KV cells.

mechanism.why_setup_and_not_pytest: Prediction pays only on near-deterministic commands. Measured P(latency>5s) and the coefficient of variation among long calls: 'apt-get update &&' 95.7% / CV 0.40; 'apt-get update -qq' 83.3% / 0.45; 'pip3 install --break-system-packages' 25.4% / 1.00; 'python3 -m pytest' 12.0% / 1.79. pytest is the LARGEST long-call group (179 long of 1489) yet yields nothing: at P(long)=12% an early fire pays the 0.94*kv restore on the other 88%, so the robust clock correctly declines to fire early and falls back to the deadline.
mechanism.deadline_itself_collapses: After ablation deadline_only earns only -6.5 s (kv=3500) and +46.3 s (kv=5000), so on non-setup commands the whole KV-swap benefit nearly vanishes, not merely its predictive component.

review.verdict: two CRITICAL findings, both fixed before this result was produced
review.critical_1: the /testbed clause was applied to the cd-stripped command instead of the command, misclassifying 5263 rows (39% of corpus) including the 'cd /testbed && ...' family the freeze names. Fixed: the clause now tests the raw command with quoted spans removed.
review.critical_2: the ablation dropped rows before balanced_task_folds, re-partitioning 239 of 277 tasks; re-scoring unablated data under the ablated partition moved kv=3500 from +20.1 to +66.9 s, more than the measured quantity. Fixed: the fold map is derived once from the full row set and held fixed across both modes.
also_fixed: clustered bootstrap implemented in-script as the criterion requires
pip3 removed (not in the frozen prefix list)
quoted /testbed no longer counts, matching the frozen text
an empty fold side now raises instead of silently shrinking the total
review.verified_by_reviewer: script totals match tool_time.policy net_saved_ms to printed precision on all three arms and both cells

limitations: Development-exposed offline accounting on Fresh-277; not a live serving result.
Does not retract C1, which is a pre-restore claim on a different decision point.
The container-setup class is a frozen string rule, not a semantic one; it groups package managers with /testbed-path commands.
The frozen 'share of advantage' band is degenerate when the two components have opposite signs; the verdict here rests on the ablation, not the ratio.
